title: HSC-26 Sailors Reunite with Families
description: 260605-N-NG136-0001 NORFOLK, Va. (June 5, 2026) U.S. Navy Sailors assigned to a detachment from Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron (HSC) 26, the "Chargers," are greeted by family and friends after returning to Naval Station Norfolk following a 10-month deployment to the Caribbean in support of Operation Southern Spear aboard the Wasp-class amphibious assault ship USS Iwo Jima (LHD 7). (U.S. Navy video by Zachary Wickline)
